# Three.js, bundled

The 3D card draws with Three.js, copied here so the page makes no third-party requests.

- Version 0.186.1, from the npm registry tarball
  `https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.1.tgz`, whose SHA-512 matched the registry's
  published integrity value when it was fetched (2026-09-28).
- Files, unmodified: `build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`,
  `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`, and `LICENSE` (MIT, Copyright 2010-2026 Three.js
  Authors). The page maps the bare import `three` to `three.module.js` with an import map.
